LanguageData.RWS_PrisonLaborResocializationsDesc: Counts colony prisoners rehabilitated into free colony members through humane prisoner treatment in Prison Labor.
LanguageData.RWS_PrisonLaborInterrogationIntelDesc: Counts successful prisoner interrogation rituals conducted by colony wardens that extract actionable quest intel in Prison Labor.
LanguageData.RWS_MedPodTreatmentsCompletedDesc: Counts completed automated medical pod healing cycles on player home maps in MedPod, broken down by pod type and excluding interrupted or empty cycles.
LanguageData.RWS_AlphaImplantsAbilitiesActivatedDesc: Counts confirmed bionic and animal implant ability activations by player colonists and colony animals from Alpha Implants, broken down by ability.
LanguageData.RWS_AlphaImplantsScarsCuredDesc: Counts permanent scar injuries cured on player pawns, colony animals, and colony prisoners by scar-curing implants in Alpha Implants.
LanguageData.RWS_BiomesIslands_HomeMapsDesc: Records active player home maps settled in Biomes! Islands biomes, broken down by biome.
LanguageData.RWS_RimQuestQuestsPurchasedDesc: Counts quests and world incident leads purchased from visiting quest-giver informants by player negotiators in RimQuest (Continued), broken down by quest or incident.
LanguageData.RWS_RimQuestSilverSpentDesc: Counts total silver paid directly to visiting quest-giver informants when purchasing quest leads in RimQuest (Continued).
LanguageData.RWS_HorrorsHivesDestroyedDesc: Counts hostile infestation hives and dens destroyed on maps with colony presence in Horrors (Continued), broken down by structure type.
LanguageData.RWS_Horrors_HomeMapsDesc: Records active player home maps settled in Horrors (Continued) wasteland biomes, broken down by biome.
